ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Gratitude? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Gratitude with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on Gratitude to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on Gratitude has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Gratitude.

   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
